text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-san, one more! One more time just 
now, one more please!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Very well, Taiki. Today, you are 
the precious girl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I shall dance for you!! Pouring heartfelt 
love... into every fiber of my being!!
